reviews.title: Almost a good drill
reviews.review_text: Seems like a pretty solid drill, but the drill bits are soft. I stripped out two Phillips head bits the first time I use them unscrewing a couple of hat hooks. They weren't even anchored. I ended up having to unscrew them the last way by hand. The drill seems to have a lot of torque, probably more than its drill bits can handle. Also, the light only comes on when you're pressing the trigger on the drill. Which isn't that helpful. And you can't store it with the battery or a drillbit on it. You have to disassemble the whole thing to get it back in its case.

reviews.title: Cordless drill review
reviews.review_text: I’m a single woman and don’t know much about drills so I got this thinking it would be fine. This drill is okay for soft jobs around the house like dry wall. But when I used it to put a fence board back up and needed some grit, it locked up and the driver bit broke in half. I’ve since tried to use it and it locks up when it needs more power. The driver bits will fall out and not stay in place as well. I guess I got what I paid for. Lesson learned.

reviews.title: No meaningful instructions included.
reviews.review_text: Seems to be a decent drill. A comfortable grip. Decent power. sturdy case. A myriad of bits and attachments. Budget some time to figure it out as the "instructions" are abysmal.
